hook: Major unions are fighting OpenAI because unauthorized AI training threatens the livelihoods of human creators.

sections.voiceover: Major unions are fighting OpenAI because unauthorized AI training threatens the livelihoods of human creators.
Will this 79-page complaint finally stop OpenAI from using creative works without permission?
SAG-AFTRA, the Writers Guild, and the American Federation of Musicians just intervened in federal court.

These unions urge the court to reject OpenAI's fair use defense regarding their 79-page complaint. The unions argue that unauthorized training on creative works directly destroys jobs for human creators.
This October 29, 2026, memorandum forces the Southern District of New York to address unauthorized scraping.
